description: This is a PHP class file defining the CommandPool class, which manages concurrent execution of commands using promises in the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles batching and asynchronous execution of commands with callback configurations.

classes.name: CommandPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of command executions with concurrency control, allowing batch processing and asynchronous handling of commands.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CommandPool with a client, commands iterable, and configuration options such as concurrency and callbacks.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all commands in the pool have completed.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a batch of commands synchronously, returning their aggregated results after all have completed.

methods.name: getBefore
methods.description: Retrieves or validates the 'before' callback function to be invoked before executing each command.
